conventions: Specs, not audio: each gives the segment as sent (a Segment, design section 7.2), the request's hints, and the transcript the ASR is pretended to return (asr.text). A pure QA test feeds asr.text to the QA logic through the fake worker; a GPU test renders render.text so that real audio carries the fault, and scores it against the segment.
kind is fault (must be caught) or non-fault (must pass).

expect.flags must be raised; expect.absent codes must not be raised at any severity; expect.absent_severity must not be raised at that severity. expect.verdict is the verdict when the checks outside the spec (speaker, pace, signal, alignment of the other cues) raise nothing.
retake_trigger: whether the take triggers an automatic retake (design 11.1).
The spoken text is in spoken form; asr.text is what an ASR writes and may hold digits and symbols.

specs.name: fault_exact_span_different_number
specs.about: The ASR hears a different number inside an exact span. A word rate alone would pass it.

cues.text: The survey counted three hundred and twelve nesting pairs along the northern shore of the lake this year.

render.text: The survey counted three hundred and twenty nesting pairs along the northern shore of the lake this year.

asr.text: The survey counted three hundred and twenty nesting pairs along the northern shore of the lake this year.

specs.note: expected and heard are reported in normalised form (design 11.3 step 1), as QA reports them (WP14).

specs.name: fault_head_insertion_three_words
specs.about: Three words are heard before the first word of cue 0.

cues.text: The tide came in slowly over the mud flats,
and by evening the channel by the old quay was full again.

render.text: Well, as always, the tide came in slowly over the mud flats, and by evening the channel by the old quay was full again.

asr.text: Well, as always, the tide came in slowly over the mud flats, and by evening the channel by the old quay was full again.

specs.name: fault_head_insertion_reference_bleed
specs.about: The last two words of the voice's own transcript are heard before cue 0: reference bleed, a known ICL failure. Two extra words alone only warn (a head insertion fails at three), so only the bleed rule fails it.

cues.text: The tide came in slowly over the mud flats,
and by evening the channel by the old quay was full again.

specs.voice_transcript: Good bread asks for patience: the dough is mixed, folded and left to rise through the morning. When the loaves come out golden and crisp, a gentle warmth fills the whole kitchen.

render.text: Whole kitchen. The tide came in slowly over the mud flats, and by evening the channel by the old quay was full again.

asr.text: Whole kitchen. The tide came in slowly over the mud flats, and by evening the channel by the old quay was full again.

specs.note: voice_transcript is the design text of canary.v1, standing in for any voice's transcript. The two extra words also raise WER_HIGH; the spec pins HEAD_INSERTION, which fails here only through the bleed rule.

specs.name: boundary_head_insertion_one_word
specs.about: One word before cue 0 is a warning, and still a retake trigger.

cues.text: The tide came in slowly over the mud flats,
and by evening the channel by the old quay was full again.

render.text: So the tide came in slowly over the mud flats, and by evening the channel by the old quay was full again.

asr.text: So the tide came in slowly over the mud flats, and by evening the channel by the old quay was full again.

specs.name: fault_token_cap_hit
specs.about: Generation stopped at max_new_tokens partway through the text.

cues.text: The wind rose steadily through the afternoon.
By dusk it was strong enough to lift the slates from the barn roof,
and the last ferry of the day stayed in harbour.

render.text: The wind rose steadily through the afternoon. By dusk it was strong enough to lift the slates from the barn roof, and the last ferry of the day stayed in harbour.

asr.text: The wind rose steadily through the afternoon. By dusk it was strong enough

specs.note: Planted with a test-only low cap (plan.md section 1.3 item 1): 60 tokens at 12 Hz is 5 s of audio, shorter than this text. The worker reports generated_tokens; reaching the cap is the fault.

specs.name: fault_unplaceable_cue
specs.about: Cue 1's words are missing from the audio and the transcript, so it cannot be placed.

cues.text: The path climbs through birch woods to the ridge.
From the top you can see across three valleys on a clear day.
The way down is steeper and takes longer than most walkers expect.

render.text: The path climbs through birch woods to the ridge. The way down is steeper and takes longer than most walkers expect.

asr.text: The path climbs through birch woods to the ridge. The way down is steeper and takes longer than most walkers expect.

specs.note: The cue's times are null and never interpolated (design 11.2 step 7). The fail verdict comes from WER_HIGH (thirteen words missing), not from CUE_UNALIGNED, which is a warning and a retake trigger.

specs.name: nonfault_one_slip_in_a_three_word_title
specs.about: One slip in a three-word title is wer_adj 0.33 with one word error: a warning, not a failure.
specs.note: wer_adj.value is rounded to four places. Fail needs wer_adj > 0.06 and at least two word errors (design 11.1).
